headline: a participation ratio compared to a constant is not evidence; the noise floor is (n-1)/n

analytic_result.claim: centred independent rows have participation EXACTLY n-1, so ratio=p/n equals (n-1)/n
analytic_result.mechanism: centring removes one degree of freedom; nothing else is shared

defect.consequence: 0.95 IS the noise floor at n=20, so the rule reports 'cross-expert sharing is LIVE' on PURE NOISE for every n <= 20. Verified at n = 4, 8, 12, 16, 20.
defect.why_it_did_not_bite_yet: both specimens measured so far have 128 experts, where the floor is 0.9919 and the verdict DEAD is correct. The rule was validated only where it happens to work.

stronger_finding.claim: O003's experts are not merely 'near-maximally independent' -- they are INDISTINGUISHABLE from independence
stronger_finding.evidence: Qwen3-30B-A3B layer 0, n=128: down_proj real 0.9796 vs norm-matched null 0.9797; gate_proj 0.9644 vs 0.9644; up_proj 0.9559 vs 0.9559. Deficit +0.00% on all three.
stronger_finding.interpretation: the entire 1.27% gap from 1.0 is explained by ROW-NORM HETEROGENEITY, not by any shared direction. An unmatched Gaussian null scores 0.9921 and would have licensed a 1.27% 'shared structure' claim that is pure artefact.
stronger_finding.consequence: this STRENGTHENS the campaign's existing conclusion. Every linear sharing class over this expert organ is dead not by a threshold but by exhaustion: there is no residual linear structure left for a shared basis, common+delta, clustering or alignment to find.

cross_layer_result.naive_reading: three MLP projections fall below 0.95, so cross-layer sharing looks LIVE
cross_layer_result.control: gaussian null 0.9255 and sign-flip null 0.9254 for gate_proj; real is 0.02% away
cross_layer_result.verdict: REFUTED. cross-layer sharing in this dense body is not distinguishable from noise.

positive_control: rows built from a rank-3 basis are detected at an 85.0% deficit, so the statistic is not merely conservative
mutations_checked: null no longer norm-matched -> pure norm spread reports a 91.17% deficit
normalise by n instead of n-1 -> independent rows stop scoring 1.0
verdict forced DEAD -> the rank-3 positive control fails
deficit hardcoded 0 -> the positive control fails

d1_null_is_aspect_ratio_dependent.claim: LOWRANK_LIVE_BELOW = 0.40 is compared against a moving target
d1_null_is_aspect_ratio_dependent.consequence: a square organ and a 3:1 organ have completely different noise floors. 0.40 never false-positives (all nulls >= 0.60) but is far too conservative for wide matrices: a 3072x1024 organ at 0.45 is called DEAD while sitting 47% below its own null.

d2_cost_claim_is_arithmetically_false.shipped_text: a rank-{rank_90} factor costs more than dense
d2_cost_claim_is_arithmetically_false.measured: O003's expert tensor is 2048x768 with rank_90 495. Dense is 1,572,864 elements; the factors are 2048x495 + 495x768 = 1,393,920. The factor costs 88.6% of dense -- it SAVES 11.4%.
d2_cost_claim_is_arithmetically_false.missing_mechanism: break-even rank is mn/(m+n) = 558.5 for this shape, and the tool never computes it. Whether structure EXISTS (deficit vs null) and whether factoring PAYS (rank vs mn/(m+n)) are two different questions the shipped rule conflated into one threshold.
d2_cost_claim_is_arithmetically_false.caveat: rank_90 captures 90% of spectral ENERGY, which is nowhere near enough to preserve capability. The engineering conclusion that low-rank does not pay here may well survive -- but the stated reason for it was false.

d3_within_expert_was_not_dead.null_calibrated: the null for shape [2048,768] is 0.8286, so 0.7171 is a 13.5% deficit
d3_within_expert_was_not_dead.consequence: real but modest structure, not the absence the threshold reported

dense_organ_heterogeneity.finding: within-tensor structure is genuinely ALIVE and strongly organ-dependent -- a 3.6x spread in deficit across organs of one layer -- while cross-layer sharing on the same body is 0.01% from its null. The two questions have opposite answers, and the shipped thresholds got both backwards: it would call the MLP organs' cross-layer sharing LIVE (it is noise) and call within-tensor low-rank DEAD (it is 12-41% real).
dense_organ_heterogeneity.consequence: this is the unequal-allocation evidence S012 sections 22 and 32 require, and it costs seconds per body to measure
